name: Pediatrix Medical Group, Inc.
summary: Pediatrix Medical Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides newborn, maternal-fetal, and other pediatric subspecialty care services in the United States. The company offers clinical care to babies born prematurely or with complications within specific units at hospitals, primarily NICUs, through its network of affiliated neonatal physician subspecialists, neonatal nurse practitioners, and other pediatric clinicians; and inpatient and office-based clinical care to expectant mothers and unborn babies through its affiliated maternal-fetal medicine subspecialists, obstetricians and other clinicians, maternal-fetal medicine nurse practitioners, certified nurse midwives, sonographers, …
